task_completion.description: Navigate to the Web-to-Lead Form creation page in SuiteCRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the SuiteCRM interface with the 'Create Web-to-Lead Form' header or the Campaign module's Web-to-Lead section.

task_completion.description: Select 'First Name', 'Last Name', and 'Email Address' as form fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing 'First Name', 'Last Name', and 'Email' (or email1) moved to the 'Form' column or selected in the field picker.

task_completion.description: Enter the specific Redirect URL in the form configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'https://www.meridian-tech.com/digital-catalog' typed into the 'Redirect URL' field in the SuiteCRM form setup.

task_completion.description: Assign the form/lead to the 'admin' user.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Assigned to' or 'Assigned User' field showing 'admin' selected in the SuiteCRM interface.

task_completion.description: Generate the form and display the resulting HTML code within the browser.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text area or modal appearing in SuiteCRM containing HTML code starting with <form> and containing 'WebToLeadCapture'.

task_completion.description: Save the generated HTML code to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the HTML content being saved to '/home/ga/Documents/tradeshow_lead_form.html'.

integrity.description: The agent used the SuiteCRM web interface to configure the form rather than just writing a script to generate the file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing mouse clicks and typing within the SuiteCRM browser window.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create the file with the required content without interacting with the CRM.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots must show the CRM configuration steps (fields, URL, user) before the file is saved.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual SuiteCRM application elements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The SuiteCRM logo, navigation menus, and specific form-builder drag-and-drop or selection elements are visible.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The form must be created in SuiteCRM. Required fields are 'First Name' (internal: first_name), 'Last Name' (internal: last_name), and 'Email Address' (internal: email1). The Redirect URL must be exactly 'https://www.meridian-tech.com/digital-catalog'. The assigned user must be 'admin'. The final HTML must contain the string 'WebToLeadCapture' and be saved to '/home/ga/Documents/tradeshow_lead_form.html'.
